summary: Duos Technologies disclosed via Form 8-K that substantially all assets of New APR Energy, LLC, in which it holds a 5% non-voting ownership interest, were sold to a third party. Duos received net proceeds of approximately $50.4 million from the sale, with an additional ~$9.9 million held in escrow for indemnity obligations, distributable after 12 months. The filing does not name the buyer, offer specific per-share or premium details, or mention a board recommendation or advisor. Structurally, this is a minority stake sale driven by an underlying asset divestiture. The escrow release timeline and potential indemnity claims warrant monitoring.
